$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_thermal 0.1.0, registry/FS_thermal/spec.md. The root applies to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_thermal, which 0.1 gives no members. FS_thermal's data lives on core elements: the data on a material, a roof or a room (its own extensions.FS_thermal) is checked as the object { C: data } against #/$defs/coreElements, C its collection, and the data on a type as { K: data }, K its kind (spec.md 1.3). That a material does not state both a conductivity and a resistance (2.1.1) and that every material reference names a material (2.2.1) are invariants, not checked here. Every value is an integer (spec.md 1.5); nothing here is an energy-code calculation (spec.md 1.4).
title: FS_thermal 0.1.0
description: Thermal properties of materials, framing through wall types, the assemblies of roofs and floors, and the U-factor and solar heat gain coefficient of doors and windows.

coreElements.title: Data on core elements
coreElements.description: 1.3: a material's, a roof's or a room's collection, or a type's kind, mapped to its FS_thermal data. Only materials, wall, door and window types, roofs and rooms carry FS_thermal data.

reference.description: 2.2: a reference to a material of the document, which has the form of an ID (Core 3.1). That it names a material is an invariant (FS-THRM-INV-002).

resistance.description: 1.5: a thermal resistance, in thousandths of a square metre kelvin per watt.

material.title: A material's thermal data
material.description: 2.1: what a material conducts and stores, and its surface.

conductivity.description: 2.1: thermal conductivity, in milliwatts per metre kelvin. Not with a resistance (FS-THRM-INV-001).

resistance.description: 2.1: a resistance stated whole, whatever the layer's thickness - an air space, a membrane. Not with a conductivity (FS-THRM-INV-001).

density.description: 2.1: density, in kilograms per cubic metre.

specificHeat.description: 2.1: specific heat capacity, in joules per kilogram kelvin.

solarReflectance.description: 2.1: the share of sunlight its surface reflects, in thousandths.

emittance.description: 2.1: its surface's thermal emittance, in thousandths.

citation.description: 2.1: where the values come from; provenance, read by no derivation.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: 2.2: a Core layer (Core 8.3): its thickness, greater than zero, its function, one of Core 4.3's, and its material.

thickness.description: 2.2, Core 8.3.1: the layer's thickness, a length greater than zero.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: 2.2: an assembly, from the outside in; at least one layer.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: 2.2: the share of an assembly's area that is framing, in place of its core layers.

fraction.description: 2.2: the share of the assembly's area that is framing, in thousandths.

wallType.title: A wall type's thermal data
wallType.description: 2.3: the framing through the type's core layers.

unit.title: A door or window type's thermal data
unit.description: 2.5: the whole unit's rating, as its maker states it.

uFactor.description: 2.5: the whole unit's U-factor, in milliwatts per square metre kelvin.

shgc.description: 2.5: the whole unit's solar heat gain coefficient, in thousandths.

roof.title: A roof's thermal data
roof.description: 2.4: the roof's assembly, from its outside surface to the ceiling under it, and its framing.

floor.title: Floor
floor.description: 2.4: the floor's assembly from the room down, its framing (which needs its layers), and the resistance of the insulation at its edge.

edgeResistance.description: 2.4: the resistance of the insulation at a floor's edge on the ground, in thousandths of a square metre kelvin per watt.
